parts.text:
An algorithm has been written in pseudocode to input 50 numbers and total only the positive
numbers.
Count ← 1
Total ← Count
REPEAT
INPUT Number
IF Number <> 0
THEN
Total ← Total + Count
ENDIF
Count ← Count + 1
UNTIL Count < 50
PRINT Total
